title: ResearchHook
description: Output contract for prompts/02-research-hook.md. found=false with empty hook is a valid, expected outcome.

found.description: Whether a qualifying hook was found. Never fabricate to make this true.

hook.description: The specific, recent, named detail usable as a cold-email opener. Empty string when found=false.

hook_quality.description: 1-5. 5 = recent + named + unique to this company; 3 = could fit a handful of competitors; 1 = nothing found. Gate: >= 4 gets a personalized first line.

summary.description: 1-2 sentences on what the business does, for the operator review screen.

facts.description: Each verifiable fact gathered, with its source.

source_urls.description: All URLs visited that support the hook. A hook with no source URL must not be used.

confidence.description: 0-1; certainty that the fact is current and correctly attributed.
